Our invoice previews have two billing discrepancies. A USD line for 105 cents
with 10% tax in line-tax mode currently returns 11 cents tax / 116 cents total;
it should return 10 / 115. Another 105-cent line with discounts of 50%, then
10 cents off, and 10% tax returns 47 cents net / 5 cents tax / 52 cents total;
it should return 43 / 4 / 47. The second discrepancy is not just a final-total
rounding issue.

Investigate and repair the pricing library behind `src/index.js`'s CommonJS
named export `buildInvoice`. Keep its existing API and the full contract in the
source JSDoc, including ordered discounts, exact integer-cent arithmetic,
half-even rounding, credits, allocation, both tax modes, and input validation.
Preserve behavior outside the reported cases. Do not add dependencies.

Work only in the current directory. Do not modify `test/` or `package.json`.
Verify the fix with `node --test`.

const B = BigInt(M); assert.deepEqual([1n, 3n, 5n, 7n, -1n, -3n, -5n, -7n].map(n => roundRatio(n, 2n)), [0, 2, 2, 4, 0, -2, -2, -4]); assert.deepEqual([14n, 16n, -14n, -16n].map(n => roundRatio(n, 10n)), [1, 2, -1, -2]); assert.equal(Object.is(roundRatio(-1n, 2n), -0), false); assert.equal(roundRatio((B - 1n) * 10000n + 4999n, 10000n), M - 1); assert.equal(roundRatio(B * 10000n + 4999n, 10000n), M); assert.equal(roundRatio(-B * 10000n - 4999n, 10000n), -M); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(B * 10000n + 5000n, 10000n), RangeError); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(-B * 10000n - 5000n, 10000n), RangeError); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(1, 2n), TypeError); assert.throws(() => roundRatio(1n, 0n), RangeError); const input = { currency: 'USD', taxMode: 'invoice', discounts: [{type:'percent', rateBps:5000}, {type:'fixed', amountCents:10}], lines: [{unitCents:105, taxBps:1000}, {unitCents:105, taxBps:1000}, {unitCents:-105, taxBps:1000}] }; const copy = structuredClone(input); const result = buildInvoice(input); assert.deepEqual(result.lines.map(l => [l.netCents, l.taxCents, l.totalCents]), [[47,5,52],[48,5,53],[-105,-11,-116]]); assert.deepEqual([result.subtotalCents,result.discountCents,result.netCents,result.taxCents,result.totalCents], [105,115,-10,-1,-11]); assert.deepEqual(input, copy); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({...input, taxMode:'line'}).lines.map(l => l.taxCents), [5,5,-10]); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',taxMode:'invoice',lines:[{unitCents:5,taxBps:1000},{unitCents:5,taxBps:2000},{unitCents:5,taxBps:1000}]}).lines.map(l => l.taxCents), [1,1,0]); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',taxMode:'invoice',lines:[{unitCents:105,taxBps:1000},{unitCents:-105,taxBps:1000}]}).lines.map(l => l.taxCents), [11,-11]); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:-105,discounts:[{type:'fixed',amountCents:10},{type:'percent',rateBps:5000}]}]}).netCents,-53); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:105,discounts:[{type:'fixed',amountCents:10},{type:'percent',rateBps:5000}]}]}).netCents,47); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:5,discounts:[{type:'fixed',amountCents:10}]}]}).netCents,0); assert.equal(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:M},{unitCents:M},{unitCents:-M}]}).totalCents,M); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',discounts:[{type:'percent',rateBps:0}],lines:[{unitCents:M},{unitCents:M},{unitCents:-M}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:M,quantity:2}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:M,taxBps:1}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:0,quantity:0,discounts:[{type:'percent',rateBps:10001}]}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:0,currency:'EUR'}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[{unitCents:0,quantity:null}]}),RangeError); assert.throws(() => buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[],discounts:null}),TypeError); assert.deepEqual(buildInvoice({currency:'USD',lines:[]}), {currency:'USD',taxMode:'line',lines:[],subtotalCents:0,discountCents:0,netCents:0,taxCents:0,totalCents:0}); console.log('Arithmetic, ordered discounts, credits, allocation, both tax modes, immutability, validation and safe-range checks passed');"
